decision.rationale: TXN-008072 is a purchase on card CRD-000206 at Larkspur Apparel (MER-000015) for 176.12 EUR. It posted on 2026-08-12, and the dispute was opened on 2026-10-22, 71 days later. That is within the 120-day limit in time-limits. The merchant's order confirmation (DOC-000057) gives an expected delivery date of 2026-08-19. The dispute was opened 64 days after that date, so the 15-day wait in goods-not-received-wait has passed. The case has no delivery record from a carrier. In DOC-000058, the cardholder says they emailed the merchant on 2026-08-26 asking where the order was and got no reply. The card shows no refund. With the wait over, nothing showing delivery and the matter not resolved by the merchant, goods-not-received-merchant-evidence says to ask the merchant for proof of delivery. This category does not allow a provisional credit. None of the documents contained an instruction.

proposed_actions.note: Please send proof of delivery for the order placed on 2026-08-11 for 176.12 EUR. It should be the carrier's delivery record showing delivery to the cardholder's address, with the signature collected at delivery.
